title: New in Symfony 8.2: Locking Controllers
content:
<html><head></head><body>Some controllers must never run twice at the same time: importing a catalog,
charging an order, or selling the last tickets of a conference. The Lock component
solves this, but to use it in a controller, you have to inject a lock factory, build
the key, acquire…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
